name: us8-reconcile-company-managed
description: 004 US1/US2 — reconcile resolves its own routing and creation context from a bound repository's own config, with no mirror environment variables set beyond the base URL. The folder-prefix rule routes the spec to COMP; the payload declares that project (never PROJ), the issue type and priority the persisted binding already discovered, and the estimation on create. Both ports must produce a byte-identical action set, exit code, and Jira API call sequence (NFR-1). No network call is made — resolution and payload assembly complete entirely from the two config layers.
